name: Scallion

schedule.notes: Sow thick — they don't compete with each other much.
Will overwinter and finish in spring in zones 6+.
Pull whole when shafts are pencil thick — or cut tops for chives-style harvest.

harvest.cues: Shaft is firm and pencil-thick. Leaves still green and standing.
harvest.storageNotes: Stems in a jar of water on the counter — keeps a week or two. Roots in damp soil regrow.

varieties.name: Evergreen Hardy White
varieties.notes: Overwinters reliably in zones 5+. The classic.

notes: Trim cut bunches in a jar of water on the windowsill — they regrow indefinitely for a few cycles. Plant in patches throughout the garden as a pest-confusing border.
